title: Five draft copy constants in form_copy.gleam are unreferenced orphans — the claimed KEEP-IN-SYNC mechanism has no mechanical guard
detail: draft_prep_note, draft_continue_button, draft_continue_sent, draft_continue_needs_email, draft_continue_failed are read by no Gleam module or test (grep: only form_view.gleam:124, a comment). The real strings live in form_draft.js; its test pins only the JS consts. The cited REVIEW_HINT_STEPPER precedent has no Gleam-side const at all.
recommended_fix: Drop the five unreferenced Gleam consts (match the REVIEW_HINT_STEPPER precedent), or add a test that pins form_draft.js strings against form_copy.gleam verbatim.

title: Migration header comments contradict the round-2 mint-at-save and tombstone fixes in the same file
evidence:
-- auth. Partial unique index — most rows have NULL (token minted lazily on
--     (POST /apply/:code/draft-erasure/:token) that removes the row.
detail: Line 24's 'token minted lazily on the first email-me-a-link request' is false after the W1 fix (upsert_application_draft.sql mints at SAVE: 'The continue token is minted at SAVE time'). Line 13's 'removes the row' contradicts the erased_at tombstone comment this same commit added ('keeps the (vacancy, email) key until vacancy close').
recommended_fix: Reword the header comments to 'token minted at first save' and 'tombstones the row (fields/token wiped, key kept until vacancy close)' — the migration is unmerged, so editing it is still allowed.

title: draft_handler hardcodes the upload-slot names that document_upload already owns canonically
detail: document_upload.gleam owns these names: pub landlord_ref_primary_key(), character_ref_primary_key(), employer_ref_primary_key(), employer_ref_coapplicant_key(index), and private is_known_field/1 (line 277). A renamed or newly added slot escapes the draft field filter silently.
recommended_fix: Expose a pub is_document_field/1 (or reuse the *_key() fns) in document_upload and call it from is_file_slot_key instead of re-encoding the strings.
